entryFilters: an entitlement or credential authoritatively granted to a named holder

primitives.asks: Is this the holder's first entitlement of this kind?

branches.label: First time
branches.test: the holder has never used this capability before and needs to be told what it is for

branches.label: Already familiar
branches.test: the holder has used this capability before - a renewal, a replacement or an additional seat

primitives.purpose: Say what is now available, what it lets them do, and the single first action that uses it.
primitives.brief: Say what is now available, what it lets them do, and the single first action that uses it. Naming one action rather than listing the capability is the difference between an announcement and an activation

primitives.purpose: Confirm the new grant briefly and name only what changed from what they already had.
primitives.brief: Confirm the new grant briefly and name only what changed from what they already had. Re-explaining a capability somebody already uses reads as a system that does not know them
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

the entitlement is revoked or replaced

branches.label: Withdrawn

primitives.reEntry: a further entitlement to the same holder is a new instance
a reissued entitlement starts a fresh window

primitives.asks: Is there still time to claim it?

branches.label: Time remains
